criteria.code: Each task attempted, runs without error, uses the required functions, and its printed output matches expected_outputs.json.
criteria.explanation: Markdown or comment explanation covers the reference concepts for tasks that ask to explain.
criteria.documentation: Headings or comments label each task; outputs are shown; no stale errors.

tasks.T1: A machine should fill 12 oz. A sample of n = 10 has mean 11.8 and s = 0.15. Test H0: mu = 12 against a two-tailed alternative at alpha = 0.05.
tasks.T2: A new method claims to raise the mean above 100. A sample of n = 25 has mean 130 and s = 15. Test at alpha = 0.05, one-tailed.
tasks.T3: Scores [62, 92, 75, 68, 83, 95]. Test whether the mean exceeds 70 at the 90% confidence level (one-tailed).
